# Real pre-4508 pane-history fixture

These JSON files are **unchanged saved bytes from a real historical server**, not
hand-authored snapshots or fingerprints generated by current code. Producer:
pre-PR master `46c995d4571da5ab7b7303e04f37dee870c7d05d`, Linux release build,
`herdr 0.9.1`. All 2,836 archived tracked files matched that Git tree before and
after building. Historical binary SHA-256:
`995ee315e3679097e70adadff1ef519f597648bc99059775eec5400742a876cc`.

Exactly one ordinary `/bin/sh` pane (`w1:p1`) in workspace `pre-4508-history`, cwd
`/tmp`, no agents, launch recipe, custom launch environment, or consent field.
With `experimental.pane_history = true`, the shell printed the standalone marker
`HERDR_PRE_PR_HISTORY_4508`, followed by 60 filler lines. The marker was readable
from recent history but outside the visible viewport. Graceful `server stop`
saved the pair, copied byte-for-byte without normalization or structural edits.

**Fixed fingerprint emitted by the historical binary:**
`0887c13fc8bee2daf7729444b633812305ce117d40934af9964b16b02b83d99b`.
Do not regenerate this expected value using the current fingerprint helper.
Real CLI upgrade tests using this `/tmp` fixture must be **Linux-gated**.

## Reproduce the old producer

The parent archived the exact master using `git archive`. Build and server/CLI
commands below describe the actual producer; choose new private roots when
repeating. The actual archive was
`/run/user/1000/smarty-pi-tmp/pi-416166c62a0b/p.dJYK87/history-baseline.UhQMlh`,
and actual runtime was `/tmp/h4508.H9qQAT`.

```bash
MASTER=46c995d4571da5ab7b7303e04f37dee870c7d05d
# A is a fresh private archive/build root; R is a short private runtime root.
git archive "$MASTER" | tar -x -C "$A"
(cd "$A"; timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=20s 1000s env \
  PATH=/home/paul/.cargo/bin:$PATH \
  ZIG=/home/paul/.local/share/zig/zig-x86_64-linux-0.16.0/zig \
  CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$A/target" ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR="$A/zig-global-cache" \
  HERDR_BUILD_COMMIT="$MASTER" just build > "$BUILD_LOG" 2>&1)
R=$(mktemp -d /tmp/h4508.XXXXXX)
mkdir -p "$R/home" "$R/c" "$R/s" "$R/r"; chmod 700 "$R/r"
printf '%s\n' 'onboarding = false' '[terminal]' 'default_shell = "/bin/sh"' \
  'shell_mode = "non_login"' 'new_cwd = "/tmp"' '[update]' \
  'version_check = false' 'manifest_check = false' '[experimental]' \
  'allow_nested = true' 'pane_history = true' '[server]' \
  'headless_cols = 120' 'headless_rows = 40' > "$R/config.toml"
E=(env -i HOME="$R/home" USER=fixture LOGNAME=fixture SHELL=/bin/sh \
  PATH=/home/paul/.cargo/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin TERM=xterm-256color LANG=C.UTF-8 \
  XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$R/c" XDG_STATE_HOME="$R/s" XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$R/r" \
  HERDR_CONFIG_PATH="$R/config.toml" HERDR_ENV=1)
H="$A/target/release/herdr"
"${E[@]}" "$H" --session hist4508 config check
cd /tmp
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 600s "${E[@]}" "$H" --session hist4508 server \
  > "$R/server-console.log" 2>&1 &
# Record $!, wait boundedly for the owned socket, and confirm status server --json.
"${E[@]}" "$H" --session hist4508 workspace create --cwd /tmp --label pre-4508-history --focus
"${E[@]}" "$H" --session hist4508 pane list
# Read P from pane list (actual producer returned w1:p1).
"${E[@]}" "$H" --session hist4508 pane run "$P" \
  'printf "\nHERDR_PRE_PR_HISTORY_4508\n"; i=1; while [ "$i" -le 60 ]; do printf "historical filler %02d\n" "$i"; i=$((i+1)); done; printf "HERDR_PRE_PR_READY_4508\n"'
"${E[@]}" "$H" --session hist4508 pane wait-output "$P" \
  --regex '(?m)^HERDR_PRE_PR_READY_4508$' --source recent --timeout 5000
"${E[@]}" "$H" --session hist4508 pane read "$P" --source recent --format text
"${E[@]}" "$H" --session hist4508 server stop
# Copy c/herdr/sessions/hist4508/{session.json,session-history.json} exactly.
# Verify with cmp and sha256sum; never replace the frozen committed inputs.
```

The actual release build exited 0 in 2m54s. Server shutdown completed normally;
all owned server/supervisor/shell processes stopped. Detailed local evidence:
`.local/history-fixture-provenance.md`, `.local/history-baseline-build.log`, and
`/tmp/h4508.H9qQAT/fixture-verification.json`.

An isolated actual cold start of the preserved unfixed merged-head binary also
reproduced the defect: logged layout mismatch, unreadable marker, then autosave
and shutdown replaced history with just `$ `. The structural save differed only
by default-false consent. See `.local/history-before-fix-probe.md` for executable
identity, exact commands, logs, saved outputs, and stopped-process evidence.
